comment.body: Adopted a mechanical order for this lane after two attempts died between finishing the patch and committing it. Commit FIRST, verify second: stage and commit every intended edit and deletion on the assigned branch as soon as the patch is complete, confirm HEAD advanced and git status --short is empty, and only then run the acceptance checks. Run the taskdb suite with its output tamed — for example cargo test -p tally-core taskdb 2>&1 | tail -30 — because the raw suite floods hundreds of kilobytes of expected daemon-event JSON and that flood is the likely killer of the two prior sessions. If a check then fails, fix and amend the commit.
